summary: Deployed async scheduling + V2 runner: step_with_batch_queue schedules, runs execute_model on rank0 (prepare inputs, FA3 metadata, paged KV write, FlashAttention) then sample_tokens, and update_from_output for that batch happens on the next iteration once the batch queue is full. Model reproduces outcome and exact path.

All 4 ranks run execute_model/sample_tokens with embedding, o_proj and down_proj all-reduces (FlashInfer, rendezvous) and rank0's output is returned; but multiproc-executor.collective-rpc joins all ranks' replies and worker-proc replies on every rank, whereas the code only replies/reads the output rank (multiproc_executor.py:425-427, 1053-1054).

Sizing reproduced exactly (requested - total_consumed - transient peak - CUDA graph estimate = 59,745,650,279 B, 28,488 blocks, correct order). Missing _check_enough_kv_cache_memory (kv_cache_utils.py:1003-1040, 2638-2647): at util 0.4 the model starts with 7,189 blocks where the code raises ValueError for max_model_len 131072.

Corrected: prefill/mixed batches up to the max capture size run PIECEWISE graphs, uniform decode FULL graphs, only larger batches eager. Model dispatches NONE:20, PIECEWISE:8, FULL:2 with matching run paths (capture size lowered to 16).

Scoped to the mp executor. Monitor marks executor failed, EXECUTOR_FAILED -> RuntimeError in busy loop -> ENGINE_CORE_DEAD -> EngineDeadError to the in-flight stream without abort and to later calls; exact path order reproduced. Probe: a non-output-rank exception fails immediately in the model, code would time out after 300 s (X2 root cause).

Worker side modeled (one FULL forward of 1+3 tokens, rejection sampler, accept-all+bonus or reject-first, next drafts proposed). End to end the scheduler never schedules spec tokens and update_from_output has no num_rejected rollback, so drafts are never verified; acceptance/target equivalence is a choice (no logits).
